# Dependencies and provenance

No third-party kernel code is vendored. Public specifications guide original code.
LLVM/LLD, Python, CMake, Ninja, QEMU and EDK2/OVMF are external tools, with their
respective licenses. Their downloaded distributions remain ignored locally.
Development Python packages: Markdown (BSD-3-Clause), jsonschema (MIT) and their
dependencies. Website output contains original HTML/CSS/JS and no remote fonts,
analytics or proprietary assets. MIT licensing of this repository does not
relicense any external tool or Windows binary.
